falsifier: a grace-credited session that also moves its XP, goal chest or Daily Most XP to the start day, a grace-credited day that renders as an ordinary flame, or a session spanning TWO local midnights that grace-credits the day it began
source: EC-STK-12 / EC-STK-13, deep/04 cases 41-45: streak to the start day, everything else to completion time, and the grace-credited day renders as a distinct half-flame cell with `Just made it!` provenance

twoMidnights.note: starts on the build date itself, not before it: an earlier start day trips the 1970-install guard (INV-DAY-14) and the row's day keying is deferred, which would hide what this case is testing

mustNotBe: a goal chest on the start day, a second chest for the same completion day, a `flame` cell for a grace-credited date, or `creditedByGrace === true` on a session that crossed two local midnights
